sent:
Priya —

Quick teardown with fixes that prove a click became a booking.

What’s leaking
- Intro Offer sits behind filters and opens Mindbody in a new tab — attribution and intent drop there.
- No real class/studio photos on key screens; feels abstract.
- Currency renders as “Â£” — small glitch, outsized trust wobble.

Fix, in this order
1) Make the offer the hero
- Homepage hero: “Start 30 days for £39” with a studio picker (Shoreditch, Hackney, Battersea, Camden, Peckham).
- Each choice → a per‑studio Intro Offer page (one screen, minimal nav).

2) Per‑studio Intro Offer page
- Sections: headline + terms (your copy), class types at that studio, how activation works, three short quotes, one real class/studio photo.
- One primary CTA only: “Claim 30 days.”

3) Booking handoff + counting
- Use Mindbody deep‑links to preselect the studio and Intro Offer (where possible).
- Persist the chosen studio across your site.
- Send users back to an on‑site “Booking complete” page after checkout to fire a booking event (with studio and source).

4) Trust tidy‑ups
- Fix the “Â£” encoding to £ site‑wide.
- Limit CTAs in the offer flow to reduce exits.

Why this moves bookings
- When ads land on a page built for one promise, they convert more. Oatside Kitchen’s shift from homepage to offer pages cut first‑order cost 38% — same principle here: one ad, one promise, one page.
